title.narrative: Harnessing culture and creativity for sustainable development in BiH

description.narrative: The proposed activities would support progress towards reconciliation within and outside BiH, by enhancing cooperation in the field of culture, the protection of cultural diversity and the promotion of cultural pluralism and strengthening the performance of the cultural, creative sector and youth, through enhanced partnerships between public and private actors, enhanced cooperation between cultural and educational institutions. Cities Sarajevo, Banja Luka and Mostar will gain greater institutional and professional capacities for the protection and promotion of contemporary arts and cultural diversity, contributing to the socio-economic development of the country.
